name: 800G OSFP optical transceiver

sources.title: NVIDIA Spectrum SN5000 hardware user manual: specifications

summary: 800G OSFP transceiver (2×400G DR4 or DR8 class) over single-mode fiber.

powerW.note: NVIDIA SN5600: (2080 W with 64 optics − 940 W with passive cables) / 64 = 17.8 W per module.

reachM.note: IEEE 802.3 DR4/DR8 single-mode reach is 500 m; FR variants reach 2 km.

capexUsd.note: Judgment from 2025–2026 street prices for 800G DR8-class OSFP modules.
